label: Transition
intent: A cut becomes a dissolve. Light: the second frame glides up over the first and stops dead in the overlap with a small knock; as it covers it, the first frame dissolves (dims) and comes back up once the second has seated, so one shot fades through the other. Strong: the second frame draws back first, drives in hard and settles in two beats, and the first frame dissolves deeper. The frames stay overlapped. The reverse is a hard cut: the second frame slides straight back out, with no dissolve, and knocks once on arrival.

reverse.//: by hand: a hard cut, so clip-a never dims; clip-b leaves and knocks once on arrival (auto would replay the knock as a false start)

clip-b.x.//: v1 end: clip-b moves (-5.5, -5.5) into the overlap

clip-a.opacity.//: the dissolve: dims as clip-b covers it, back to full once clip-b has seated
